levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Presentation omits one of the three required parts (what worked, what didn't, backup plan), or the backup plan is vague.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Presentation names one specific thing that worked, one specific thing that didn't, and one specific backup plan naming the trigger and the different action.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All three parts are specific, and the learner connects the reflection to a concrete next step for one system going into the rest of the year.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Guardian confirmation is missing, or no follow-up question is recorded.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Guardian confirms the presentation happened, live or via the initialed script, and confirms asking at least one follow-up question.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Guardian confirmation is present, and the learner accurately records the specific follow-up question asked and their own answer to it.

lookFors: A backup plan that names both the specific trigger and the specific different action, not just 'I'll do better.'
A guardian confirmation of both the presentation happening and at least one follow-up question being asked.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
